parameters.line_angle: PCA of living enemy centres; smallest axis change modulo pi; pre-death prepare endpoint
parameters.exposure: inclusive native enemy band, sampled at post-step positions of living committed own guns
parameters.simultaneity: first post-wave prepare snapshot with ceil(.8*n) living guns reaching current shared target; P5 not applicable
parameters.outcome: descriptive matched patterns, bundled mechanisms not causally identified; mixed patterns inconclusive
parameters.beat_p5: greater mean enemy gun kills and greater mean gun exchange (kills minus own gun losses)
parameters.p9_adds_nothing: does not improve both mean kills and exchange above best qualifying P7/P8
parameters.sanity: regular P5 mean own gun losses [7,10], enemy guns destroyed [1,6]; report before reading others
